schema_description: Resolved bootstrap-CI metadata sidecar for leaderboard_all_evaluations.json (combined / cross-architecture, Era 1).
notes: Era 1 combined / cross-architecture leaderboard. Pools all 93 conditions across 2 populated architectures (single-pass=21, consensus=72) into a single greedy-clique BH-FDR-tiered ranking, separately at each (buffer, metric, q-level) combination. Era 1 has no PV or single-pass+PV cells. Within-architecture pairwise tests reused from per-architecture caches at results/leaderboard/per-architecture/era1/<arch>/.cache/; only cross-architecture pairs (1,512 per buffer) computed fresh. See results/leaderboard/combined/README.md for methodology.
